front_entry.name: Front Entry
front_entry.description: A narrow entryway crowded with shoes, umbrellas, and a corkboard thick with takeout menus and a hand-drawn chore chart.

living_room.name: Living Room
living_room.description: A worn but comfortable couch, string lights, a coffee table that's never quite clean, and the TV nobody can agree what to watch on.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description: Small and bright, with a whiteboard for grocery lists, mismatched mugs, and the smell of whoever cooked last still lingering.

player_bedroom.name: Your Room
player_bedroom.description: Still mostly boxes. The one space in the house that's fully yours, for now half-unpacked.

mina_room.name: Mina's Room
mina_room.description: Tidy, warm-lit, decorated with photos of the whole house through the year.

daeho_room.name: Dae-ho's Room
daeho_room.description: Guitar cases stacked against the wall, cables everywhere, a mattress on the floor.

priya_room.name: Priya's Room
priya_room.description: Color-coded folders, a desk lamp that's always on, a laundry hamper labeled with a schedule.

shared_bathroom.name: Shared Bathroom
shared_bathroom.description: One mirror, four toothbrushes, and a shower schedule nobody actually follows.

backyard_patio.name: Backyard Patio
backyard_patio.description: A small concrete patio with mismatched chairs, a string of solar lights, and an ashtray nobody claims.

rooftop_balcony.name: Rooftop Balcony
rooftop_balcony.description: Up a narrow stairwell, away from the noise of the house — the spot people go when they want to think, or talk, without an audience.
